purpose: Create provisional market values for Phase-2 EV expansion from exact-identity realized raw sales without using completion-queue proxy values as valuations.
rules: Exact product family, set, card number and parallel must match before a sale can enter the valuation sample.
Only raw/ungraded realized sales are eligible.
Use at most the 10 most recent exact-identity realized sales visible in the discovery source at research time.
Exclude wrong product families, Sapphire, wrong parallels, numbered variants when Base is targeted, and graded copies.
Market value is the median of the retained exact realized sale prices.
Secondary-source realized sales produce provisional-only market values and EV contributions.
If zero exact realized sales remain after identity filtering, keep the slot unvalued and persist the blocker.
Do not infer an unvalued slot from its completion-queue market anchor, neighboring parallel, guide price, graded price or another product family.
Phase-2 provisional market records do not expand the frozen v1 27-contribution / 72-sale verification scope.
Future market-evidence-v2 may replace or qualify provisional values using a separate original-marketplace sample.
